controls: The keyboard and mouse drivers were positive-controlled before being trusted: Win+R then typing a marker string, screenshotted, showed 'drc-keyboard-control-works' in the Run box; SetCursorPos was confirmed by reading GetCursorPos back and by the cursor landing on the intended control.

The payload HTTP server was positive-controlled from the host (200, 217297383 bytes) and then from inside the guest (curl -sI -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK) before Edge was involved, so a failed download could not be misread as a missing file.

The mouse helper was made to fail loudly rather than silently: it retries three times and exits non-zero unless the guest echoes CURSOR=. This caught a real dropped click during the uninstall confirm step, which had previously looked like a click that landed - the earlier silent version had already caused one screenshot to be misread as 'the menu did not open'.

The baseline suite first came back exit 1 with '139 passed, 0 failed, 1 not run - test:server'. Re-running it, per the shared-tree rule, gave 140 passed / 0 not run / all passed, and running test:server alone also passed; the NOT CHECKED was transient, not a red tree.

Any real game connection; the app ran in mock mode throughout.

What the 'Hmv-da1480-ola1015 - unavailable / Retry' item on the first screen is. Recorded as an observation, not diagnosed.
